profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at WP Engine
profile.summary:
My preferred role involves building backend APIs using Go / Python, Kubernetes and Google Cloud.

Email: eric.haase@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/erichaase

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer at one of the leading WordPress hosting platforms, serving more than one million customer sites across more than 150 countries

Created and managed an internal, next-gen Platform API consumed by various services throughout the organization. Implemented using Go, Kubernetes, gRPC, Protocol Buffers and numerous Google Cloud products (Team Lead)

Awarded best AI hackathon project for creating a Slackbot to allow users to chat with our internal documents. Implemented using a RAG architecture and Google Cloud Vertex for the vector store and LLM.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Created and managed an internal Kubernetes-based platform which hosts over 100 backend APIs for various application teams. The platform integrates an Istio service mesh, GitOps architecture, Cloud Native technologies and numerous Google Cloud products. The product was recognized by Google Cloud as a 2021 DevOps Award Winner for implementing DevOps practices to drive organizational success: https://wpengine.com/blog/unleashing-the-full-power-of-the-cloud/

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
WP Engine API development (Ruby on Rails), public API used by customers to manage their account and sites: https://wpengineapi.com (Team Lead)

Smart Plugin Manager development (Go and Kubernetes), automatically updates customer sites' plugins: https://wpengine.com/smart-plugin-manager (Team Lead)

company.name: IBM, POWER Open Source and Solutions

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented support for batch processing and tag specification to the POWER AutoPort component, a RESTful web application that automates the process of pulling GitHub projects and building/testing them on a Jenkins server (Python, Flask, JavaScript, Rivets and Bootstrap)

Supported the porting of Node.js and the V8 JavaScript Engine to the POWER platform

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Added support for unicast clusters and live-updating the AIX kernel to Cluster-Aware AIX, a component that provides distributed, high-availability, AIX kernel services powering numerous IBM products (C and Shell)

Lead transition of migrating testing team's Functional Verification Testing Framework to development (Shell)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented IPv6 and loopback device support for the Network Installation Manager component, a layer of various cloud computing stacks used to administer systems; owned over 350 KLOC (C, Shell, Perl and Java)

Owned, maintained and delivered enhancements including IVM platform support to the OS_install component, a cross-platform network operating system installer for AIX, VIOS and Linux (object-oriented Perl)

Added IPv6 and Linux support to the Activation Engine component, a framework used to customize rapid-image deployments on virtualized, large-scale, enterprise networks (object-oriented Perl and Shell)

Resolved various defects within the JFS and logical file systems, AIX's default file systems (C)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted with Sketch Understanding research, involved various approaches to pen-based symbol recognition

Created a symbol recognizer using Hidden Markov Models, an efficient technique commonly used in speech recognition software (Python)

company.name: University of California, Riverside, Smart Tools Laboratory

positions.title: Academic Part-Time
positions.description:
Provided support for the Cassini-Huygens Mission to Saturn System Engineering department

Webmaster of the Cassini System Engineering website (HTML, CSS and JavaScript)

company.name: JPL (NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory), Cassini Mission to Saturn

certifications.name: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification
